regulations.enforcement_body: City of Boulder Planning & Development Services
regulations.notes: STRs must be the operator's primary residence. The STR license is 4 years long ($190 application fee + $25 business license annually). ADUs may be licensed as STRs but are limited to 120 rental days per year; non-ADU primary residences have no day cap. One unit per owner is allowed as an STR. Entire home rentals are allowed.
